# McNamara Law, PLLC

> McNamara Law, PLLC is a law firm in Orlando, Florida, led by attorney Matthew McNamara, Esq. The firm represents individuals, families, and businesses in Central Florida in five practice areas: family law, immigration, civil litigation, criminal defense, and personal injury.

## Firm facts

- Name: McNamara Law, PLLC
- Attorney: Matthew McNamara, Esq. (founder)
- Founded: 2024
- Office: 3769 Seminole Dr, Orlando, FL 32812

- Email: matt@mclawfl.com

- Book a consultation: https://mcnamaralaw.cliogrow.com/book
- Area served: Orlando, Winter Park, and Central Florida (Orange, Seminole, and Osceola counties)

## Family law (Florida)

McNamara Law handles contested and uncontested family-law matters throughout Central Florida.

- [Family law overview](https://www.mclawfl.com/family-law): all family-law services, the stages of a Florida family case, and contact details
- [Divorce](https://www.mclawfl.com/divorce): contested and uncontested dissolution of marriage, residency, process, and property division
- [Child custody and timesharing](https://www.mclawfl.com/child-custody): parenting plans, the equal timesharing presumption, and best-interest factors
- [Child support](https://www.mclawfl.com/child-support): how Florida calculates support, duration, and enforcement
- [Modifications](https://www.mclawfl.com/family-law-modifications): changing child support, parenting plans, and timesharing
- [Paternity](https://www.mclawfl.com/paternity): establishing paternity and rights of unmarried parents
- [Alimony](https://www.mclawfl.com/alimony): types of alimony after Florida's 2023 reform, duration, and modification

Other family-law services: enforcement and contempt, relocation, property division, and prenuptial and postnuptial agreements.

## Other practice areas

- [Immigration law](https://www.mclawfl.com/immigration): family and marriage-based green cards, consular processing, employment and investor visas, asylum, waivers, citizenship, removal defense
- [E-2 treaty investor visas](https://www.mclawfl.com/e2-visas)
- [Civil litigation](https://www.mclawfl.com/civil-litigation): contract, fraud, business, and consumer disputes
- [FDUTPA and auto dealer / repair shop claims](https://www.mclawfl.com/fdutpa-consumer-claims)
- [Criminal defense](https://www.mclawfl.com/criminal-defense): representation before and after charges are filed
- [Personal injury](https://www.mclawfl.com/personal-injury): car accidents, slip and fall, premises liability
- [Car accident injuries](https://www.mclawfl.com/car-accidents)

## Notes
